Не понял, но. Если река проходит по центру гекса предлагаю случайно обходить гекс по ребрам слева или справа.
Точки интереса внутри 6 мильного гекса смещать к реке, если они должны быть у реки. Дороги тоже смещать к точке интереса, если она сместилась, внутри точки интереса дорогу не показывать, если точка интереса занимает целый гекс или больше. Я ответил?
resolution: Owner supplied concrete direction compatible with B: route river around existing hex edges with random left/right choice and adapt dependent POI/roads; previous recommendationA is not approved. No further A/B decision is required.

owner_requirements.requirement: If river crosses a hex center, detour along that hex's edges left or right, choosing side randomly.
Move POI toward its required river within the same6mile parent hex when its placement rules require river adjacency; do not move unrelated POI merely because a river exists.
Adapt roads attached to a moved POI so that they still reach that POI.
Do not display the road inside the occupied footprint of a POI that occupies a whole hex or more.

analyst_operationalization.note: No owner approval for proposedA grid rephase or address migration. Adapt geography rather than shifting grid.
Same accepted map does not reroll detour on6↔1, pan/zoom/style/export/reopen; define deterministic keyed choice or persisted result without consuming globalworld RNG on view.

Edge river route → required river-side POI within same6mile parent → attached roads/crossings → visual road mask. Preserve stable entity IDs, crossing kinds and coherent attachments/connectivity; reconcile6/1 representations explicitly.

Mask line only inside actual footprint, not delete road entity/connectivity. Whole-cell threshold is understood in context of1mile detail, not any-pixel icon; formalize measured/manual extent and boundary/entrance semantics.

Define explicit application/compatibility/UndoRedo/JSON and conflict/loss behavior. Owner permits necessary within-parent geometry adaptation; no silent lost manual content or unrelated-object migration.
